label: A holder of another that is MOTION_3 held in the act by which it holds is a link of a holding series
paraphrase: OPEN analyst premise, attribution deferred (holding per se link): if y, distinct from x, presently actualizes x in r and is itself MOTION_3 held in r, then y is a link AsHeld y x of a holding series: it holds x only as held. AsHeld is a parameter (definition 439f943a-1bf1-4659-8fa4-cf6b83feb708), the holding counterpart of the per se link MovesAsMoved of the prima via, not that relation. Respect-indexed: being held in another respect does not make y a link. With the holding regress it excludes mutual holding in one respect (two cards leaning on each other), a case of ordinary statics; see the argument concluding that no two beings hold each other.
